posts.title: Detecting Frida Stalker
posts.description: Frida’s Stalker spills its scratch registers after the red zone. This blog post shows how this mechanism can be used to detect if a function is stalked.

posts.title: A Glimpse Into DexProtector
posts.description: This blog post provides a high-level overview of DexProtector’s security features and their limitations

posts.title: Fuzzing Windows ARM64 closed-source binary
posts.description: This blog post introduces coverage-guided fuzzing with QBDI and libFuzzer targeting Windows ARM64.
